title: Guard Core built-in patterns can block the application event loop
summary: Built-in penetration-detection regexes run without the timeout wrapper used for custom patterns. A crafted request causes quadratic processing without recording a detection match.

severity.rationale: The security middleware itself permits unauthenticated denial of service. Running the regex on the event loop can block all endpoints in the process.

exposure: Applications using the affected built-in detection patterns can be attacked through ordinary request content under the default configuration.

params.instructions: Check guard-core version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
